policies.Root: All four roots use their actual original Deathrattle controller and ordinary semantic shuffled/AddToDeck. Complete client COLLECTION_RELATED_CARD_DATABASE_ID proves the exact generated Prime. No ordinary-pool selection or fake generic upgraded body.
policies.Vashj: Existing spell damage1 on both bodies. Prime performs three original physical matching spell draws, each with ordinary original-draw reduction3; no spells means no matching draw/fatigue/RNG. Burn, cast-when-drawn, original hand residence, waiting and ordinary costs remain in the shared pipeline.
policies.Kargath: Both bodies have printed Rush. Prime rewards only its actual completed attack killing a minion by the original COMBAT damage/poison result inside that attack range and original source residence. Original living-source trigger policy, original accepted controller, generic armor effect; no later health or broad death-event scan.
policies.Zixor: Both bodies have printed Rush. Prime performs three ordinary attributed current CopyMinion requests on its original continuous board presence. Each actual copy captures at its ordinary execution window, honors source loss/current changes and quantity/capacity, and does not run Battlecry.
policies.Kanrethad: Original removable source cost aura discounts friendly current Demon minion cards1. Prime uses one frozen ordinary friendly Demon death inventory and Resurrect(count3,distinct=death), not original entity movement or copied old buffs. All graveyard/member weighting, new printed bodies, quantity, capacity and notifications stay shared.

uncertainties: Within one Kanrethad Prime the current ordinary Resurrect profile selects original death occurrences without replacement; different casts do not consume the graveyard. Exact official replacement/weighting and death-face tribe boundaries remain explicit local policy pending CN calibration, not inferred from public text.

Kargath uses existing living-source attack-completion trigger policy, including no reward if the source is already dying and no counterattack/hero/unrelated-destruction reward. Exact simultaneous death/control trigger windows remain deferred.

Three Zixor copies use original continuous presence and ordinary per-request current capture; changing or losing the source during earlier notifications follows that existing policy. No invented independent freeze/combination mechanism is added.
Vashj follows original typed matching-draw hand residence and discount continuation. Precise cast-when-drawn/transformation/overflow/reaction windows retain existing local policy.

Official launch description confirms named upgraded Prime shuffles and gives original Zixor/Kanrethad examples; current complete fixed rows and full bilingual card responses are the operative content pins. The launch article does not settle unresolved internal timing/random-selection rules.
Other four Prime families and the full past732/other goal domains stay open. Parent and generated-body implementation does not certify a full past source or official Standard eligibility.
